newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures chop higher, yen swings.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures chop higher, yen swings.

text.p: May 8 - IMM currency futures sharply higher, yen bounced and retreated. June yen hit highest level since March 3 high at $.008451. Analysts tied surge to jawboning by Japan officials, interpretations of Fed Greenspan Thurs speech to mean economy could slow, Fed keep rates steady. Some said June yen could hit $0.008482 or $0.008518, about 118.50 and 118.00 spot.
